protocolAuthority.finding: Network.loadingFailed is an independent failed-load event with requestId, timestamp, type, errorText and optional canceled; it declares no responseReceived prerequisite. The same authority explicitly documents failed requests for which no responseReceived event is triggered.
The loadingFailed payload has no response-presence field or response dependency.

correctnessFindings.detail: A requestWillBeSent followed by loadingFailed without responseReceived is a lawful terminal CDP chain. Treating it as globally inconsistent was stricter than the protocol authority.

The failure row, canceled flag, privacy-safe error, disqualification reasons, sequence, target binding and summary counts remain observable. Only the invalid derived fatal inconsistency is removed.

failure-without-request, response-without-request, reused request ID, duplicate response, duplicate terminal, session/frame lifecycle, timestamp, cap, redirect-taint and body-settlement guards are unchanged.

All eight failures are noncandidate canceled hillshade PMTiles range fetches. The two response-less chains fail five independent admission predicates. Three OGG Media requests have request-to-206-response-to-finish chains; therefore zero target-like failures and zero body attempts are the correct retained classification.
